definition.zero_state: A fully decoupled symmetry condition possessing zero distinction and zero degrees of freedom.

domain_rule.reading: Zero-State is not admissible within the distinction domain.

entry_condition.name: Asymmetric Recoupling
entry_condition.reading: The distinction domain becomes accessible only through the generation of asymmetry and recoupling.

critical_consequence.statement: The first distinction is identical to the first successful asymmetric recoupling.

remaining_work: Determine whether RT exists below the distinction floor.
